reader.requirement: At --std 85 a file whose entry says [ORGANIZATION IS] RELATIVE must be a permanent structure in which each record is identified by an integer greater than zero giving its ordinal position: records persist across CLOSE and OPEN at their numbers, a number less than 1 identifies no record, and the structure is not reinterpreted by another organization (GR1's permanence, which GR2 states as a property of the structure).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError: key < 1 on a random WRITE is '24' below 2014, '34' from 2014

reader.edition-search: read FileControlBinder.MapOrganization (no edition test), RelativeConnector Write/ReadRandom/Start; grep DialectBehavior/Edition in RelativeConnector.cs and FileControlBinder organization arm.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the status of a random WRITE with key < 1 ('24' at 85, '34' from 2014); the structure and the greater-than-zero identification are the same.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1098_organization_permanence_85 is a free-format case the probe helper (fixed form) could not run, so this slice's own probes carry the evidence: positive numbers persisting across CLOSE/OPEN, key 0 refused by WRITE/READ/START

probes.printed: records 1,2,3 written by one SELECT, record 7 by a second SELECT on the same file, all read back after CLOSE/OPEN in order 1,2,3,7,8; WRITE key 0 -> INVALID KEY 24, READ key 0 -> 23, START = 0 -> 23
probes.expected: each record identified by an integer greater than zero, permanent across opens; zero identifies no record

probes.printed: key 2147483647 WRITE 00 and READ back 'MAX '; key 999999999999999999 WRITE INVALID KEY 24
probes.expected: any positive number within the implementor's boundary identifies a record; beyond it the write is the invalid key condition 24 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4)

probes.printed: not run: the case is free-format and the run helper compiles fixed form (COBOL2616 on every line); recorded so the gap is visible

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.2.5.3 GR2  (2.5.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR2
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3c

reader.notes: MapOrganization maps RELATIVE with or without ORGANIZATION IS at every edition; the relative store keys records by a positive RRN and every key below 1 is refused (WRITE 24 at 85, READ/START 23). Records persist across CLOSE/OPEN and across two file-names on one physical file.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-027/org.cob (org-001), ORGANIZATION written as bare RELATIVE: second random WRITE of key 3 -> INVALID KEY 22 (uniquely identified; §1985:VIII.1.3.4 22 'duplicate key in a relative file'); REWRITE 3 replaces at its number, READ 3 CCCC; REWRITE of absent 2 -> 23; DELETE 3 then READ 3 -> 23, re-WRITE 3 -> 00 and READ EEEE. orgneg.cob: a signed RELATIVE KEY PIC S9(4) is refused COBOL0863, so a value below 1 cannot be named by a signed key. A SEQUENTIAL SELECT on the same physical relative file OPENs INPUT with 00: GR1 permits that because §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR8 'The implementor defines which of the fixed file attributes are validated', and the open does not change the organization. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.2.5.3 GR2 the text is in GR2; OK §1985:VIII.2.5.3 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (GRL2.3a); OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR8. Side note: COBOL0863 at --std 85 cites §2023:12.4.5.13.3 SR2.
